Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive epoxy; and a solvent.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface, wherein the electronic component is a silicon chip.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface, wherein the solvent is vaporized by heating the electronic component surface. 

Claim 9 (Currently amended): A composition comprising cavity-generating particles, a thermally conductive binder, and a solvent wherein the particle to binder ratio is about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the solvent being about 10 ml per gram of particles, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive epoxy.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the solvent is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87, wherein the solvent is used as a carrier.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive premixed solder paste.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity-generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys, wherein the cavity-generating particles are 8-12 μm in size.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity-generating particles are 30-50 μm in size.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity-generating particles are 100-200 μm in size.
